Just general reading in what used to be substantial subs, like askscience. The questions are middle school level, which happens now and again but seem more common recently, but he answers, which used to be excellent, sound like they are coming from highschool students. The engineering subs are about dead except for stupid questions and comparable answers with nowhere near the participation as in the past. Maybe the noise is drowning legitimate responses...

I wouldn't say just legitimate responses, but drowning. The perceived drop is due to another recent rise in the site's popularity. Just think that all the mouthbreathers who's Internet access extended to Facebook and Google now also extends to reddit.

The site has just gained a lot of popularity like any form of media. The change wasn't so dramatic either, it could just be that more people have observed this behaviour because attention is being brought towards it.

I do find it interesting that you would blame any childish behaviour on children. I don't really try and guess age online, as I find it too unreliable for determining general maturity. Just try to keep in mind that childish behaviour does not always come from children.

I didn't mean that to be derogatory, I meant it to be descriptive. It is literally like children, say middle schoolers, have begun to predominate. These subs were fairly intellectual or professional in their answers and usually in their questions until the last few weeks. Simple minded questions with the same quality answers, which is a change from what is normal in these subs. It is like middle and high school suddenly discovered Reddit; perhaps a solid mention in the media or online where that age group hangout?

Getting a job at a supermarket when I was 16 changed my view of adults. a lot are nothing more than grown children. Seeing them bitch and complain to get what they want is no different than a little kid crying because they want a cookie. The attitude is the same but the priorities are different.

I was there for a few years and noticed a major shift toward YouTube tone and quality of comments around the time of the Fappening. I also discovered just how much censorship was taking place (SRS vote brigades, Ellen Pao articles disappearing from the front page).

Welcome to eternal September. It happens to most, if any site. Hell, it'll probably happen to Voat eventually.

Basically what happens is that the number of new users surpasses the number of older users (age of account, not necessarily age of the person), and the tone of the conversation changes because they do not follow the etiquette set up.

One of the few places this has been prevented is /r/askhistorians. They delete silly questions, heavily mod comments, and while allowing topical conversation and debate, do not allow tangents that go into stupid realms.

Let's get the ball rolling on this group. There are millions of concealed carriers in the US (And other parts of the world, too) who responsibly and legally carry daily. Below is my 'rig'.

http://i.imgur.com/SsPAvIc.jpg

Kahr CM9 (Great, American made pistol) that is blacked out with Dawson Precision night sights added. I also stippled the frame for better grip. Using the 7 round magazine by Kahr (with Hornady +P 135 gr Critical DUTY ammo), though depending on my attire and how fitting it is I may use the flush fit 6 round magazine instead. It rides in a Shepherd Holster (also made in the USA!) IWB and I can wear this all day and it's super comfortable. For what it's worth, I also have a N82 Tactical IWB holster which is comfortable, but doesn't conceal as well as this.

For the belt (should have taken a photo, sorry) I rock a BladeTech gun belt that I ordered from Amazon (but they're now out of all reasonable sizes).

I love this rig. Easy to conceal, comfortable, and the Kahr is a great gun. The trigger takes some getting used to but many agree it's buttery smooth. The stock sights I wasn't much a fan of, as they "i" sights ( see: http://i.imgur.com/SBs9Hwj.jpg ) but the 3-dot night sights are much much better.

What about you, what's your concealed carry rig?
What is your concealed carry rig?

Depends.

I mostly carry my M&P 45 in an Aliengear holster, these days. If I'm openly carrying I just use an $11 Blackhawk holster that I got from Walmart. I replaced the stock trigger, sear and striker block with this kit (I used the green spring).

If bulk is an issue (dress clothes and such) then I'll carry my XDs 4.0 9mm, also in an Aliengear.

I have a Daltech Force double layer buffalo hide belt that makes whatever I'm carrying disappear both in terms of how well it holds my piece of choice against my body and how well it distributes the weight around my waist.
Walther PPS 9mm, loaded with Speer Gold Dot 147gr 9mm in the 7-round mag, carried in either my Alien Gear Clock Tuck 2.0 or my new Remora Tuckable at 5:00
I carry a West German P226 in a G-Code IWB kydex holster with a 20 round Magazine of Speer.
